841542ad1d038a8e0813de665b67320c2ccf74bc.sourceText: MID360仍挂在gimbal_yaw，随实际yaw转动、不随pitch转动；两条odom关节固定。建图使用底盘系，不意味着可以将MCU世界姿态当机械关节角，也不改变这些机械约定。
841542ad1d038a8e0813de665b67320c2ccf74bc.translatedText: MID360 is still mounted on gimbal_yaw, rotating with the actual yaw and not with pitch; the two odom joints are fixed\. Using the chassis frame for mapping does not mean that the MCU world pose can be treated as a mechanical joint angle, nor does it change these mechanical conventions\.

84ebb67d8c91954cb2f277595eba39ca19de830d.sourceText: 17项都在启动时声明和读取，没有动态参数更新回调；运行时仅写同名参数不会更新算法中的成员变量。`clearingDis` 可由清图消息改变量，这与重新读取 ROS 参数是两回事。衰减计时使用输入点云时间戳，不是电脑墙钟；本块未列 `use_sim_time`，也不能据此证明全链路时钟或点内时间单位已经正确。
84ebb67d8c91954cb2f277595eba39ca19de830d.translatedText: All 17 items are declared and read at startup, with no dynamic parameter update callback; at runtime, merely writing parameters with the same names will not update the member variables in the algorithm\.`clearingDis`It can change the quantity via clear\-map messages, which is a different matter from re\-reading ROS parameters\. The decay timing uses the input point cloud timestamp, not the computer wall clock; this block does not list `use_sim_time`, nor can it be used to prove that the full\-chain clock or the intra\-point time unit is already correct\.
